posts.title: In April
posts.description: In April My late wife Judy and I made this garden thirty years ago. posts.title: A Chapel and Pasta Pomodoro
posts.description: A Chapel and Pasta Pomodoro When I was young, I sought out everything that was new. I made a pilgrimage to see Le Corbusier’s Ronchamp chapel in France. I was so affected by its majesty that I felt ill. But then an Italian friend said that it’s best to eat what you see. Her kitchen window overlooked wheatfields, tomato plants, basil, and garlic.
